questions.q: The left elevon deflects the wrong way on both the roll stick and the pitch stick. The correct fix in INAV:
options: Enable roll channel reverse on the radio
A negative rate in the servo command of this servo
Change the sign of the roll weight in the smix of this servo
Swap the connectors of the left and right servos on the board
questions.explain: If a servo is wrong on both axes, it has to be reversed as a whole: rate with a minus sign. The sign of a weight in smix is changed when the error is on one axis only. A reverse on the radio breaks the agreement between stabilization and the stick.

questions.q: The OSD shows 16.08 V, the multimeter — 16.42 V, the current vbat_scale = 1100. The new value:
questions.explain: In battery.c the voltage is proportional to vbat_scale: 1100 × 16.42 / 16.08 ≈ 1123.

questions.q: Over the flight the flight controller counted 2860 mAh, the charger put in 3180 mAh, current_meter_scale = 250. The new value:
questions.explain: The current in INAV is inversely proportional to scale (microvolts / scale), hence the Battery.md formula: 250 × 2860 / 3180 ≈ 225. The flight controller undercounted, so scale decreases.

questions.q: Why does a wing need failsafe_throttle_low_delay = 0?
options: So that the motor does not stop in the middle of the RTH procedure over home
So that at zero throttle in a glide failsafe does not disarm the wing as if it were on the ground
So that failsafe triggers at once, skipping the 0.5 s failsafe_delay
So that autolaunch is not enabled again on a brief link loss
questions.explain: If the throttle has been low for longer than this delay, INAV considers the aircraft landed and simply disarms it. A wing glides at zero throttle, so the check is turned off (Failsafe.md).

questions.q: nav_fw_loiter_radius = 3000, cruise 15 m/s, nav_fw_bank_angle = 35°. What happens over home?
options: The wing holds the 30 m radius with about 25° of bank in any wind
The wing goes on to land because the radius is below the 50 m minimum
About 37° of bank is needed, which is above the limit, and the circle comes out wider than 30 m
The firmware temporarily raises nav_fw_bank_angle to 45° for the circle
questions.explain: tan φ = V²/(g·R) = 225/(9.81·30) ≈ 0.76, φ ≈ 37°. The bank is limited to 35°, so the radius comes out larger than set.

questions.q: What does fixed-wing AUTO TUNE change in INAV 9.1 (pid_autotune.c)?
options: Only FF and the rates per axis
P, I and D on all three axes
The servo centers and the pitch trim
The autolaunch thresholds and the cruise throttle
questions.explain: The code writes pid[axis].FF and stabilized.rates[axis]. P and I are tuned by hand; it was the same in 8.0.1, and the documentation text about PIFF was corrected in 9.1. You have to save after disarm with the stick command.

questions.q: Servo autotrim (the SERVO AUTOTRIM mode) ran in flight. The switch was turned off while still in the air, then you landed and disarmed. The result:
options: The new centers are saved on disarm
Centers averaged over the whole flight are saved
The old centers came back, the new ones are not saved
The centers are reset to 1500 µs
questions.explain: In servos.c leaving the mode in the SAVE_PENDING state restores servoMiddleBackup. Saving happens only on a disarm with the switch still on.

questions.q: The Flying Wing preset was edited by hand. Why is this fragment dangerous?
questions.fragment:
set platform_type = AIRPLANE
smix 0 1 0 50 0 -1
smix 1 1 1 50 0 -1
smix 2 2 0 -50 0 -1
smix 3 2 1 -50 0 -1
servo 1 1000 2000 1500 100
servo 2 1000 2000 1500 100
options: The 50 % weights are too small, and the surfaces will not reach the stops
On the pitch stick the elevons move apart, as for roll
Servo 2 is reversed in roll and in pitch at once
A smix rule for the motor is missing
questions.explain: In the preset the pitch weight of both servos is +50. Here servo 2 has −50: on the pitch stick the elevons go in opposite directions, and that is already a roll command. The motor is set by mmix, not smix.
